subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Picking up my earlier note on retargeting browsers to a paid order for {Brand}. Since platform ad costs climbed 40 to 60 percent since 2022, customer acquisition for delivery apps now runs $45 to $85 per user, against $15 to $20 not long ago (Rosario 2026). At that cost, every order Uber Eats wins back has to be incremental to pay off. We run paid orders against a holdout, so the orders we report are additive and your organic returners stay off the bill. Worth comparing to your cost per kept order?
angle: fresh angle: delivery ad-cost inflation 40-60% since 2022 (sourced) + $45-85 CAC band
